mechanism: Lactulose may reduce gastrointestinal transit time and potentially decrease absorption of betamethasone; betamethasone can cause hypokalemia which may be exacerbated by lactulose-induced diarrhea and electrolyte loss.
action: Monitor serum potassium and electrolyte levels; consider timing lactulose administration away from betamethasone dosing and assess clinical response to betamethasone therapy.
